post_commit_sha.resolution: Resolve the containing commit with git log -1 --format=%H -- CHECKPOINTS/LIVE_MODEL_009_VALIDATION.json
post_commit_sha.reason: A committed file cannot contain the literal hash of its own containing commit without changing that hash.

remote_verification.procedure: After normal push fetch origin/main; run validate_live_model_009.py --root . --verify-remote and write a new external receipt with --report. Require local/fetched/live SHA equality, zero divergence, clean tree and eight exact fetched content samples.
